title: 동료의 부탁 거절하기: 미안하지만 오늘은 어려워요
objective: Politely refuse a coworker's request, give a reason, and offer another option, using -던데.
summary: A coworker politely turns down a request and suggests someone else.
setting: An office in the afternoon. Jisu is behind on a report and asks her coworker Mark for help, but Mark has an urgent task of his own.

task.title: Practice polite refusals
task.line: Use the dialogue and the expressions above to complete each task.

words.meaning: I noticed that... (gives background from something you saw before)
words.example: 그 식당 점심에 사람이 많던데, 일찍 가세요.
words.exampleMeaning: I noticed that restaurant gets crowded at lunch, so go early.

words.example: 동료에게 부탁하기 전에 먼저 바쁜지 물어보세요.
words.exampleMeaning: Before you ask a coworker for a favor, first ask if they are busy.

words.meaning: Oh, I'm sorry... (softens bad news before a refusal)
words.example: 어떡하죠? 오늘은 약속이 있어서 못 남아요.
words.exampleMeaning: Oh, I'm sorry. I have plans today, so I can't stay late.

words.meaning: I don't think I can (a soft way to say no)
words.example: 이번 주말 근무는 좀 어려울 것 같아요.
words.exampleMeaning: I don't think I can work this weekend.

words.example: 오늘은 안 되고, 대신 금요일에 도와 드릴게요.
words.exampleMeaning: I can't today, but I'll help you on Friday instead.

words.example: 다음 주에는 일정에 여유가 좀 있어요.
words.exampleMeaning: My schedule is a bit freer next week.

words.example: 이번 주에 벌써 두 번 야근했어요.
words.exampleMeaning: I've already worked late twice this week.

dialogue.korean: 내일까지 내야 하는 보고서가 있는데, 표 정리하는 것 좀 도와줄 수 있어요?
dialogue.meaning: I have a report due tomorrow. Could you help me sort out the tables?

dialogue.korean: 아, 어떡하죠? 저도 도와 드리고 싶은데, 오늘은 좀 어려울 것 같아요.
dialogue.meaning: Oh, I'm sorry. I'd like to help, but today will be hard for me.

dialogue.korean: 어제 보니까 마크 씨도 야근하던데, 요즘 일이 많죠?
dialogue.meaning: I saw you working late yesterday too. You've got a lot of work these days, right?

dialogue.korean: 네, 아까 팀장님이 회의 자료를 급하게 찾으시던데, 그걸 오늘 안에 끝내야 하거든요.
dialogue.meaning: Yes. Earlier the team leader was looking for the meeting materials in a hurry, and I have to finish them today.

dialogue.korean: 미안해요. 민수 씨가 오늘은 좀 여유가 있어 보이던데, 한번 물어보면 어때요?
dialogue.meaning: Sorry. Minsu looked like he had some free time today. Why don't you ask him?

exercises: Join the two sentences with -던데 to share what you noticed: ① 수진 씨가 아까 회의실에 있었어요. + 거기 가 보세요. ② 하준 씨가 엑셀을 잘해요. + 하준 씨한테 물어보세요.
Choose the most polite refusal. A coworker asks you to work on Saturday for them: (a) 싫어요. 안 해요. (b) 도와 드리고 싶은데, 토요일은 좀 어려울 것 같아요. (c) 왜 저한테 부탁해요?
Fill in each blank with 대신, 야근, or 여유: ① 오늘은 못 가요. ____ 내일 같이 가요. ② 요즘 일이 많아서 매일 ____을 해요. ③ 오후에는 시간 ____가 좀 있어요.
Answer in Korean: A coworker asks you to write the notes for Friday's meeting, but you have a business trip (출장) that day. Turn the request down, give your reason, and offer something else.
answers: ① 수진 씨가 아까 회의실에 있던데, 거기 가 보세요. ② 하준 씨가 엑셀을 잘하던데, 하준 씨한테 물어보세요.
① 대신 ② 야근 ③ 여유
Example: 어떡하죠? 금요일에는 출장이 있어서 어려울 것 같아요. 대신 다음 주 회의록은 제가 쓸게요.
